nights.title: Paris Paloma
nights.name: Paris Paloma
nights.extract: Paris Paloma is a British singer-songwriter and guitarist. She gained prominence through the single "Labour" (2023). Her debut album, Cacophony, was released in 2024. Her second album, The Fatal Flaw, followed in 2026.

en.who: Paris Paloma is a British singer-songwriter and guitarist. Her second album, The Fatal Flaw, followed in 2026.

Her debut album, Cacophony, was released in 2024.

nights.title: Caravan Palace
nights.name: Caravan Palace
nights.extract: Caravan Palace is a French electro-swing band based in Paris. The band's influences include Django Reinhardt, Vitalic, Lionel Hampton, and Daft Punk. The band released their debut studio album, Caravan Palace, on the Wagram label in October 2008. The record charted in Switzerland, Belgium, and France, where it reached a peak position of number 11.

nights.title: Rizzle Kicks
nights.name: Rizzle Kicks
nights.extract: Rizzle Kicks are a British hip-hop duo from Brighton, England, consisting of Jordan "Rizzle" Stephens and Harley "Sylvester" Alexander-Sule. Their debut album, Stereo Typical, was released in 2011. As of May 2012, Rizzle Kicks had sold over one million singles and over 600,000 albums in the UK.

nights.title: Boko Yout
nights.name: Boko Yout
nights.extract: Boko Yout is a Swedish music group. Previously, the group's singer Paul Adamah, born 1998 in Örebro, used the name Boko Yout as a stage name for his solo project, but since 2025 Boko Yout became a group with the addition of Kevin Stierne on bass and Joel Kiviaho on drums.

en.who: Boko Yout is a Swedish music group. Its singer, Paul Adamah, previously used the name as a stage name for a solo project.
facts: Boko Yout is a Swedish music group.

nights.title: Myles Smith: My Mess, My Heart, My Life. Tour
nights.name: Myles Smith
nights.extract: Myles Michael Smith-Thompson is a British singer. He is best known for his 2024 singles "Stargazing" and "Nice to Meet You". His debut studio album, My Mess, My Heart, My Life. was released on 19 June 2026.
